packages.title: Add discount code functionality
packages.description: In src/shop/pricing/discounts.py add a module-level function apply_discount(total, code) next to the existing subtotal function (leave subtotal unchanged). total is a number; code is a str or None. Behavior: code None -> return total unchanged. code "SAVE10" -> return total * 0.9 (10% off). code "FLAT5" -> return max(total - 5, 0) (5 off, never below 0). Any other code (including other strings) -> raise ValueError.

must_cover: Keep existing test_subtotal; change the import to `from shop.pricing.discounts import subtotal, apply_discount`

packages.title: Update order to use discount codes
packages.description: In src/shop/orders/order.py: change Order.__init__ to Order.__init__(self, items, discount_code=None) and store it as self.discount_code. Change Order.total() to return apply_discount(subtotal(self.items), self.discount_code). Import it with `from shop.pricing.discounts import subtotal, apply_discount`. apply_discount(total, code) already exists: code None returns total unchanged, "SAVE10" takes 10% off, "FLAT5" takes 5 off (min 0), any other code raises ValueError (so Order.total() raises ValueError for an unknown code). Do not change place_order.

must_cover: Keep existing test_total and test_place_order unchanged

packages.title: Add stock checking to order placement
packages.description: In src/shop/orders/order.py, rewrite the existing function place_order(order, stock) (do not touch the Order class). order.items is a list of (name, unit_price, qty) tuples; stock is a shop.inventory.stock.Stock with methods available(name) -> int and take(name, qty) (take raises ValueError if fewer than qty are available). place_order must check every line before taking anything: first total the requested qty per item name across all lines, and if for any name stock.available(name) is less than the requested total, raise ValueError without calling take at all, so the stock is left unchanged. Only if every line can be fulfilled, call stock.take(name, qty) for each line.

must_cover: Keep existing tests (test_total, test_place_order, and any discount tests) unchanged
place_order with sufficient stock for two lines reduces both levels
place_order where the first line is fulfillable but the second is not raises ValueError and leaves both levels unchanged (e.g. Stock({"a": 5, "b": 1}), lines a qty 2 and b qty 3)
place_order for an item not in stock raises ValueError

packages.title: Update stock to prevent over-allocation
packages.description: In src/shop/inventory/stock.py, change Stock.take(self, name, qty) so that if self.available(name) < qty it raises ValueError and does not modify self.levels. Otherwise it subtracts qty as it does now. Leave __init__ and available unchanged.

must_cover: take of exactly the available amount leaves 0
take of more than available raises ValueError (pytest.raises) and available() is unchanged afterwards
take of an unknown item name with qty > 0 raises ValueError
